convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iBands, iDEMA). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries. No grid, martingale, or hedging logic. Straightforward new-bar-gated market execution.

other_exits: Long closed when bear candle crosses below Upper Band (close<BBUp and open>BBUp)
Short closed when bull candle crosses above Lower Band (close>BBLow and open<BBLow)

custom_logic_notes: Multi-timeframe: Bollinger Bands use PERIOD_M30 hardcoded while DEMA uses PERIOD_D1 hardcoded, regardless of chart timeframe. Entry conditions use bar[1] (previous completed bar) for candle/Band crossovers but bar[0]/[1]/[2] for DEMA trend direction. Close position volume uses the input Lot parameter rather than reading the actual open position volume, which may cause partial close or rejection if position size differs from Lot.
python_conversion_notes: Two indicators needed: Bollinger Bands (period=20, dev=2) and DEMA (period=20). Note the hardcoded multi-timeframe: BB on M30, DEMA on D1 — Python backtest must resample or fetch both timeframes. Entry uses previous bar (index 1) for crossover detection. Close logic is signal-based (opposite crossover) with no SL/TP. Position gate uses simple no-position check (flat only). Close volume is hardcoded to Lot input, not actual position volume — may need correction in Python to use actual position size.
